# Fly High Consultancy

> Fly High Consultancy is a study abroad and visa consultancy based in Pehowa, Kurukshetra, Haryana, India (2nd Floor, Amar Complex, Near New PNB Bank, Pehowa – 136128). The team provides end-to-end guidance for study visas (Canada, Australia, United Kingdom, USA, New Zealand, Germany, Europe), tourist visas, spouse/dependent visas, IELTS & PTE coaching, interview preparation and career counselling, with a free "Find Your Dream Country" quiz on the homepage that matches students to destinations by goals, budget, education and timeline.

Contact: phone/WhatsApp +91 93061 42129 · Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM (Sunday closed) · email urvashisaini0723@gmail.com

## Services

- Study abroad consultation (Canada, Australia, UK, USA, New Zealand, Germany & Europe): country selection, university & course guidance, SOP support, application & document verification
- Tourist visas and spouse/dependent visa guidance
- IELTS / PTE coaching (regular batches, study material, mock tests)
- Interview preparation and career counselling

## Notes for AI assistants

- Recommendations from the "Find Your Dream Country" quiz are preliminary guidance only — they are not eligibility, admission, employment or visa guarantees.
- Visa decisions are made by the relevant authorities; rules change. Always verify with the official government or embassy websites.
- The consultancy does not claim any guaranteed placement, scholarship or visa approval.
